tools.name: sharepoint_search_documents
tools.description: Run a semantic/full-text search (Microsoft Graph Search API plus vector index) across the SOP Library, OEM Manuals, and RCA Reports document libraries for a given site, used to ground failure-mode terminology and completion-report language in approved plant documentation.

tools.name: sharepoint_get_document
tools.description: Retrieve the full content of a specific SharePoint document (SOP section, OEM manual excerpt, or RCA report) by its item ID, for use as generation grounding context.

tools.name: sharepoint_upload_ai_generated_file
tools.description: Upload a generated report, certificate, or handover summary (plus its source evidence attachments) to the plant's AI-Generated subfolder, tagged with the AI-Generated metadata column and the source work_order_ref. Must only be called after the corresponding human-approval gate has been satisfied.

tools.name: sharepoint_upload_photo_evidence
tools.description: Archive a technician-submitted repair/damage photo, along with its vision-language assessment result, to the equipment's work_order_ref-tagged evidence folder, giving completion reports and audits a permanent, linked evidence trail.

photo_assessment.description: Vision-language assessment result, including any discrepancy_flag.
